correctness.rationale: Each side-foot condition is a strict convex strip; chord unit tangent differs from arclength tangent by at most κh. For any z in the kernel, |<z-γ(s),τ(s)>|≤2(1+Dκ)h uniformly in s, yielding Δ bound. Compactness and derivative of squared radius prove Δ=0 precisely for circles. On ellipse, maximum tangential residual at origin is a-b and antipodal pairing shows no translation can lower it. For even n central symmetry of the entire strip kernel permits z=0 when nonempty; direct midpoint/chord dot product gives the precise bound a²/b²<tan((2j+2)x)/tan((2j+1)x) for restrictive j, equality excluded. Minimize continuous f_x at π/4-x/2 and sample within x to get R_n=1+π/n+O(n^-2). n=4 admits all positive ellipse aspect ratios. Limits of smooth and finite regimes explicitly separated.
